marco_fin: Heads up 1  Fenix Labs filed a billing dispute (TKT-7712). AE promised an onboarding experiment credit (ONBOARD_EXP_2026) that didn't make it onto invoice 82377. They're asking for a manual credit + corrected invoice.

tina_csm: yikes. can you paste invoice lines? need SKU codes for credit memo.

marco_fin: invoice excerpt:
```
Invoice 82377
- Reserved cluster: FEN-RESV-PRO: $9,000
- Overages: FEN-USG: $1,200
- Discounts: $0 (expected ONBOARD_EXP_2026 -> 50% reserved)
Total: $10,200
```

olivia_billing: quick check 1: was the credit percent-off reserved only or a flat waiver?

tina_csm: AE confirms 50% off reserved for first month only. expected credit = $4,500.

jake_cfo: i'm fine approving $4.5k one-time adjustment to keep the partner happy. GL code?

olivia_billing: GL = 5120 (Promotions & Partner Credits). i'll generate credit memo CM-2026-0110 and reissue invoice 82377-R1. tagging reason = "ONBOARD_EXP_2026_ADJ".

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-0110 created for $4,500. Reissued invoice 82377-R1 (net due $5,700). Link: https://billing.internal/reports/invoice/82377-R1

olivia_billing: emailed credit memo and corrected invoice to Fenix; cc'd AE and CS. added note to billing-run checklist: experiments must have token in SF and billing webhook before cutoff.

marco_fin: thanks 1. also requested sales-ops to add a pre-cutoff confirmation step. closing after Fenix acknowledges receipt.

tina_csm: will follow up with AE and log a retro in pricing-experiments board. :memo:
